t: This is Ladbroke Grove, a long road running north to south between Harrow Road and Holland Park Avenue, passing through Kensal Green and Notting Hill. The name comes from James Weller Ladbroke, a nineteenth-century landowner who was the main developer of the Ladbroke Estate in Notting Hill. Many streets nearby still carry his name, and the old estate is now a conservation area. Plenty of people have called this road home, among them the actress Charlotte Hudson and the artist Jason Brooks, and the rapper and producer Rakin Fetuga was born here.
